behaviors.title: Guest users can enter the learning loop without a configured remote backend
invariants: A user can begin the learning loop without creating an account when Supabase is unavailable.
Shared client, server, and simulation payloads continue to use the repository's shared contracts.

scenarios.title: Guest entry remains available without remote configuration
scenarios.oracle: A browser or component test with Supabase unavailable reaches the guest learning entry point, reports the local fallback state, and does not require account creation.
